verdict.rationale: The docs state that high-end machine types such as the NVIDIA H100 require an approval request before use [paperspace-docs-17], which is a minimal access-gating process. They also document a few isolated limits, such as storage resizable up to 2 TB [paperspace-docs-29] and up to 8 GPUs per machine [paperspace-docs-11]. Missing for 10: a documented account-level quota/limit table (instance counts, GPU quotas per region), a defined quota-increase request workflow or SLA, visibility of current usage against limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
